column8: Probable SYN flooding attack: 3 TCP handshakes to one server port left half-open (reset by the client, or no final ACK within 1 s); the victim is ip.dst:tcp.dest_port of the reported packet, at most one alert per server port per second
SYN flood: high SYN rate to one destination, replies not required (default: 100 SYN within 1 s to one IP address and port)
